C-APEX-RESPONSIVE-SERVICES.Summary: Add Beyond the Apex magazine beside GT Auto and make the home Services section responsive.
C-APEX-RESPONSIVE-SERVICES.Problem: Services reserves oversized grid cells while the visible cards retain content-sized heights, creating a large empty gap before Daily Races. A fourth service and an in-app Apex reader are missing.

Goals.Goal: Show Auto Market, Hagerty, GT Auto and Beyond the Apex in that order with consistent visual card proportions and content-driven section height.
Provide a Flutter magazine reader based on the official Russian Beyond the Apex: five chapter groups, article navigation, readable text and original illustrations.

Constraints.Constraint: Use the FVM SDK, existing Provider architecture and auto_route; new feature UI belongs under lib/widgets/apex and external fetching belongs in a service.
Use available width for breakpoints, preserve image aspect ratios and allow wrapped labels and increased text scale.
Keep official content attribution and a link to https://www.gran-turismo.com/ru/gt7/apex/; do not invent article content.
Preserve existing uncommitted audio work and keep crash investigation outside this change.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No redesign of telemetry, Profile, Wishlist or Daily Races, no authentication changes, no offline download library.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Four service cards appear without horizontal overflow or a reserved empty grid row, with consistent card artwork areas and readable labels.
Layout uses one column where two cards cannot fit, two columns on intermediate widths and four on wide widths; all available row width is distributed evenly.
Apex opens from its card inside the home navigation branch and supports chapter/article selection and returning home.
Wide reader uses side-by-side contents and article; narrow reader exposes contents through a drawer or sheet. Loading, network errors and retry are visible.
Widget checks cover widths 320, 390, 600, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1920 and increased text scale, including real navigation taps.
Run the app and visually inspect narrow and wide layouts and Apex article navigation; do not claim untested platforms are verified.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Layout bounds and overflow checks, fixture-based official-content parser tests, reader selection and retry tests, live application screenshots at narrow and wide widths.

Assumptions.Assumption: Apex is a native in-app reader with the official site's chapter-and-article structure, adapted to the existing dark application theme.
Reading official content requires network access; errors provide retry and a link to the original.
